description: Finalize a draft through the committability gate. The server runs deterministic graders against the gold (must PASS), rejects ≥1 declared negative case, requires a recorded, decorrelated independent verification that agrees with the gold, embeds any resolved captures, and checks for duplicates; on pass it flips the record to submitted, stamps submitted_at and a checksum, and freezes it. It refuses with a typed error otherwise and the record stays a draft. For free_response, llm_rubric is not executable by this server; the record is admitted on recorded independent verification and flagged server_verified=false.

confirm.description: When true, require client confirmation through multi-round input before finalizing (also triggered by EVALS_REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION).

draft_id.description: The draft record id to finalize.

name: evals_submit_draft

checksum.description: The SHA-256 immutability anchor stamped at submit.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No record exists with the given draft id. `record_frozen`: The id refers to an already-submitted record. `verification_incomplete`: No recorded independent verification (no subagent report and no author decorrelated check). `grader_failed_on_gold`: The declared grader, run against the declared gold, did not return PASS. `verification_disagrees_with_gold`: A recorded independent verification computed a value that disagrees with the gold. `missing_negative_case`: discrimination.negative is empty — nothing proves the grader rejects a wrong answer. `negative_case_passed`: A declared negative case passed the grader when it should be rejected. `duplicate`: A submitted record with the same content_hash already exists. `decorrelation_violation`: The recorded verification path is the same as the generation path (no genuine independence). `capture_unresolved`: A captures EvalsID has no file in EVALS_CAPTURE_DIR (only when capture is enabled). `submit_declined`: A required human confirmation was declined or cancelled. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

frozen.description: Always true — the record is now immutable.

grader_run.description: The grader verdicts produced by the gate.

gold.description: Whether the gold passed the grader (SKIPPED for llm_rubric).

server_verified.description: True when the grader ran server-side; false for llm_rubric admitted on recorded verification.

id.description: The finalized record id (unchanged across submit).

path.description: The on-disk path of the frozen submitted record.

verification.description: The decorrelation provenance the gate accepted.

title: evals-mcp-server: submit draft
